                   Large Loads Co-Located at Generating Facilities, Docket No. AD24-11-001
                   Constellation Energy Generation, LLC v.
                    PJM Interconnection, L.L.C., Docket No. EL25-20-001
                   PJM Interconnection, L.L.C., Docket No. ER26-1479-000
                   Notice of Partial Compliance Filing

Dear Secretary Reese:

         This notice, being served on all parties to the above-referenced proceedings, confirms that
on August 17, 2026, the PJM Transmission Owners, acting through the Consolidated Transmission
Owners Agreement, submitted a filing in partial compliance with the Commission’s June 18, 2026
order in these proceedings.1 The PJM Transmission Owners submitted the partial compliance
filing in Docket No. ER26-3537-000.

        As required under the June 18 Order, the PJM Transmission Owners submitted new and
revised tariff records to establish the rate for Interim Network Integration Transmission Service
(“Interim NITS”). The filing was a companion filing to PJM’s August 17, 2026 filing of the terms
and conditions of Interim NITS.

                                                             Respectfully submitted,

                                                             /s/ Michael Kunselman
